upright.general: The Magician symbolizes personal power, creativity, intelligence, and the ability to transform ideas into reality. It represents focus, resourcefulness, and mastery over circumstances.
upright.in_love: Strong attraction, confident communication, and active romantic energy. A relationship may begin through charm, initiative, or mutual inspiration.
upright.in_situation: The situation favors decisive action and strategic thinking. You possess the necessary tools and abilities to succeed if you remain focused.
upright.meaning_for_today: Today is favorable for taking initiative, using your talents, and turning ideas into reality. Your confidence and skills can help you achieve meaningful progress.
upright.card_advice: Use your abilities wisely and act with purpose. Focus your energy on what truly matters and trust your capacity to create results.

reversed.short: Manipulation, deception, misuse of power, insecurity.
reversed.general: The reversed Magician points to dishonesty, manipulation, scattered energy, or lack of confidence. Talents may be wasted or used for selfish purposes.
reversed.in_love: Miscommunication, emotional games, or unrealistic promises may affect the relationship. One person may hide their true intentions.
reversed.in_situation: The situation becomes unstable due to poor planning, deception, or lack of direction. Greater clarity and honesty are required.
reversed.meaning_for_today: Today you might cross paths with a smooth talker who talks a big game but has hidden motives, or you could find yourself on the receiving end of some manipulative office politics. On a personal level, your focus is likely fragmented. You have all the tools you need to succeed right in front of you, but self-doubt, impostor syndrome, or a total lack of willpower might prevent you from executing your plans. Watch out for a temptation to cut corners or bend the truth to get what you want.
reversed.card_advice: Beware of smoke and mirrors, whether they are coming from someone else or your own self-deception. The reversed Magician advises you to audit your intentions today. If you are trying to force a result through manipulation or half-truths, stop—it will backfire. If you are feeling stuck, stop trying to multitask; gather your scattered energy and focus intensely on mastering just one thing at a time. True manifestation requires alignment and integrity, not tricks.
